lane: Mobile app: Council errors in the room, question kept, bounded history (CO-03; TA-15 record)
goal: CO-03: a failed or limited Council turn shows only a toast and, for a generic failure, leaves the question in the thread with no answer. Show the reason inside the room, give the question back for every failure, and bound each history turn sent to the server (persona chat already caps at 800 characters) so long councils stay under the 32 KB request limit. Canned turns are already labelled (fallback flag). Also record that TA-15 is already fixed by the Tarot draw redesign (6e0fdfd).
successCriteria: useAiCouncilRoom exposes roomNotice; a limit, pause, sign-in or generic failure sets it, and the next send clears it.
Every failure removes the unanswered question from the thread and puts it back in the box.
AiCouncilRoom shows roomNotice as a system bubble.
Each sanitizedHistory turn text is at most 800 characters.
Hook tests cover the generic failure and the history cap; app tests and tsc pass.
Backlog TA-15 marked done with evidence TarotDrawStep tests (fan draws, drawn slot opens full screen).
untouchedSurfaces: Sending persona ids instead of full persona profiles needs a server change; left for a later slice.
